declare module "shop" {
  export interface Cart {
    readonly id: string;
    add(item: Item, count?: number): void;
    total(): number;
  }
  export function open(id: string): Cart;
  export const version: string;
  export type Item = { sku: string };
}

declare function helper(x: number): string;

declare class Legacy {
  constructor(name: string);
  run(): Promise<void>;
  static create(): Legacy;
}
